dhikr: All praise is due to Allah.
Glory and praise be to Allah.
I seek forgiveness from Allah, the Almighty.
O Allah, send blessings upon our Master Muhammad.
There is no deity except Allah, and Muhammad is His Messenger.
There is no power and no strength except with Allah.
Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
guide:
Prayer Postures for Men

  1. Takbir: Raise hands up to earlobes.
  2. Qiyam: Clasp hands below the navel.
  3. Ruku: Bow with back completely flat (90 degrees).
  4. Sujood: Keep elbows lifted from the ground and stomach away from thighs.
  5. Sitting: Sit on left foot with right foot upright.

Prayer Postures for Women

  1. Takbir: Raise hands up to shoulder level.
  2. Qiyam: Place right hand over left on the chest.
  3. Ruku: Bow slightly with knees slightly bent and hands on knees.
  4. Sujood: Keep arms close to sides and body compact.
  5. Sitting: Sit on left hip with both feet extended to the right.

Step-by-Step Wudu

  1. Make intention and say Bismillah.
  2. Wash hands, mouth, nose, face, and arms 3 times.
  3. Wipe head and ears once, then wash feet 3 times.

Summary of Daily Rakahs

  • Fajr: 2 Sunnah + 2 Fard
  • Dhuhr: 4 Sunnah + 4 Fard + 2 Sunnah
  • Asr: 4 Sunnah + 4 Fard
  • Maghrib: 3 Fard + 2 Sunnah
  • Isha: 4 Sunnah + 4 Fard + 2 Sunnah + 3 Witr

Jumu'ah Prayer

Performed in congregation on Friday instead of Dhuhr: 4 Rakah Sunnah, listening to the Khutbah, 2 Rakah Fard in congregation, followed by 4 Rakah Sunnah.

Eid Prayer (2 Rakahs)

Includes 3 extra Takbirs in each Rakah: In the 1st Rakah, after Subhanaka, raise hands 3 times (drop sides on first two, fold on the 3rd). In the 2nd Rakah, after recitation, raise hands 3 times before bowing on the 4th Takbir.

Daily Remembrance (Dhikr)

  • SubhanAllah (33x): Glory be to Allah.
  • Alhamdulillah (33x): All praise is due to Allah.
  • Allahu Akbar (33x): Allah is the Greatest.
  • La ilaha illallah: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.
  • Astaghfirullah: I seek forgiveness from Allah.
